    19	  | [], _ => 0
    20	  | a :: tail, x => a + x * P tail x

    22	/-- Horner evaluation with exactly two rounding operations per list step. -/

    25	  | a :: tail, x => model.round (a + model.round (x * Q model tail x))

    27	/-- The prescribed forward-error envelope, independent of rounded evaluation. -/
    28	def E : List ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

    32	      let e := E tail x u

    35	lemma rounding_perturbation (model : Model) (z t : ℝ) :

    38	  have hr : |model.round z - z| ≤ model.u * |z| := by
    39	    rw [hz, show z * (1 + δ) - z = z * δ by ring, abs_mul]
    40	    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ (abs_nonneg z)]
    41	  have habs : |z| ≤ |t| + |z - t| := by
    42	    calc
    43	      |z| = |t + (z - t)| := by congr 1; ring
